_about: DEVELOPMENT set for unvocalized Modern Standard Arabic prose (news, encyclopedia and simple narrative register). MACHINE-WRITTEN and MACHINE-ANNOTATED by the Arabic pack's builder (an AI model), NOT a human gold standard: lemmas, parts of speech and clitic breakdowns were written one token at a time from grammar knowledge and may contain mistakes. Every sentence is original; none is copied from a corpus. FROZEN on 2026-11-25, before the analyser read it. An independent auditor holds a separate held-out set. Tokens with "skip": true (proper names and words whose vocalized lemma the annotator was not sure of) are not scored. See docs/arabic/EVAL.md.
annotator: the pack builder (AI), not a human
